purpose: Immutable self-scoped idempotency receipt for CreateEvent, binding one operation identifier and normalized intent fingerprint to exactly one canonical Event identity plus the accepted initial Agenda snapshot needed for stable replay after later Agenda edits.

columns.name: self_person_ref
columns.meaning: Authenticated self Person that scopes the operation identifier.
columns.value_contract: Existing Person NativeRef; operation identity remains technical and distinct from Event identity.

columns.name: operation_id
columns.meaning: Caller-supplied idempotency identity for one CreateEvent attempt stream.
columns.value_contract: Trimmed, non-empty, at most 200 characters; same scope and id may replay only the same immutable intent fingerprint.

columns.name: intent_fingerprint
columns.meaning: Canonical lowercase SHA-256 fingerprint of normalized CreateEvent intent.
columns.value_contract: Exactly 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters; changed intent with the same operation id is a conflict.

columns.name: event_ref
columns.meaning: The one canonical Event NativeRef created or replayed by this operation.
columns.value_contract: References one existing Event and is unique across create-operation receipts.

columns.name: accepted_agenda_parts
columns.meaning: Ordered initial Agenda snapshot accepted by this CreateEvent operation.
columns.value_contract: At most 100 normalized values. Pre-B03-D receipts are truthfully backfilled to the empty Agenda; this typed receipt snapshot is not a second current Agenda store.

columns.name: created_at
columns.value_contract: Recorded by the bounded PostgreSQL CreateEvent capability in the same transaction as canonical creation.

primary_key.name: pk_event_create_operation
primary_key.reason: The self-Person scope plus operation identifier is the database arbiter for CreateEvent idempotency.

foreign_keys.name: fk_event_create_operation_self_person_ref_person
foreign_keys.semantic_reason: Idempotency is scoped to an existing authenticated self Person without becoming a Domain identity.

foreign_keys.name: fk_event_create_operation_event_ref_event
foreign_keys.semantic_reason: A successful operation receipt resolves to exactly one existing Event identity and never acts as that identity itself.

unique_constraints.name: uq_event_create_operation_event_ref
unique_constraints.reason: Prevent multiple create receipts from claiming creation ownership of the same Event identity.

check_constraints.name: ck_event_create_operation_operation_id
check_constraints.reason: Require one bounded normalized operation identity.

check_constraints.name: ck_event_create_operation_fingerprint
check_constraints.reason: Require the canonical SHA-256 hexadecimal fingerprint representation used by CreateEvent replay comparison.

check_constraints.name: ck_event_create_operation_accepted_agenda_parts
check_constraints.reason: Keep the immutable create replay snapshot within the accepted Agenda cardinality bound.

indexes.name: pk_event_create_operation
indexes.reason: Indexed database idempotency arbiter for self-scoped operation lookup and locking.

indexes.name: uq_event_create_operation_event_ref
indexes.reason: One-to-one receipt ownership of the created Event identity.

state_history.current_binding: The receipt is immutable technical control state and never participates in Event, Schedule or MaterialState identity/currentness. accepted_agenda_parts is the initial command response snapshot, not current Agenda truth.
state_history.chronology: created_at records receipt establishment; operation id and UUIDv7 are not chronology substitutes.
state_history.immutability_policy: The receipt is immutable after initial B03-D snapshot establishment. Replay compares the stored fingerprint and returns the accepted initial Agenda snapshot; later Agenda mutations never rewrite it.

lifecycle.retention: Retained while needed to preserve safe CreateEvent replay semantics for canonical Event creation.
lifecycle.delete_behavior: No runtime DELETE. B03 downgrade remains fail-closed around canonical Event/Agenda truth.

obligations: same self-Person operation id plus same normalized Event intent replays the original Event and initial Agenda snapshot even after later Agenda edits
same self-Person operation id plus changed intent is rejected
pre-B03-D Event create receipts map truthfully to an empty initial Agenda snapshot
runtime has no generic DML authority on the receipt
one Event identity cannot be claimed by multiple create-operation receipts
